subject: Vendor portal registration and PO/invoice routing — FreightLine
messages:
From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elena Morales <elena.morales@freightline.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-08-21T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Vendor portal registration and PO/invoice routing — FreightLine

Hi Elena,

Great to connect — thanks for taking the time earlier. We’re ready to get Redwood set up as an approved supplier in FreightLine’s vendor registry so PO issuance and invoice routing are smooth. To speed things up, I’ve attached a short AP onboarding packet with our legal entity, banking, and tax details. Can you confirm the following on your side?

- The preferred vendor portal (Coupa / Ariba / custom) and the registration link we should use
- Required fields on your vendor record for PO matching (PO number, line-item mapping, remit ID, invoice reference)
- File format for e-invoices (PDF, UBL/Peppol, EDI) and whether you support invoice IDs in the invoice XML header
- Any VAT proof or tax forms FreightLine requires for non-US suppliers (we are US-based but have EU VAT passthrough for some customers)

Attached: Redwood_AP_Onboarding_Packet_v1.pdf (includes entity/legal name, W-8/W-9 info, SOA contact)

We’re also happy to pre-fill your portal registration if you share the link or a CSV template. If FreightLine issues POs with special payment terms or top-line validations, please include an example PO so our billing system can validate before submission.

Thanks — I’ve cc’d Ben (payments) and Marissa (SalesOps) to help with any follow-ups.

Quick next steps I propose:
1) You confirm portal + required fields
2) We submit registration + sample invoice in test environment (if available)
3) FreightLine issues a test PO and we validate acceptance and remittance

Best,
Rachel Kim
Head of Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference
rachel.kim@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0123

From: Elena Morales <elena.morales@freightline.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: finance@freightline.com
Date: 2026-08-21T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor portal registration and PO/invoice routing — FreightLine

Hi Rachel — thanks for the packet, that’s helpful. A few notes from Procurement/Finance: 

- Portal: please register here — https://vendors.freightline.com/register (custom portal). If you hit issues, send the CSV and we’ll load it ourselves.
- PO requirements: Our POs must include the external PO number, remit ID (FreightLine Remit ID), tax classification code, and supplier legal name exactly as on the onboarding packet. Line-item PO matching is optional for services but required for goods.
- Invoice format: PDF is accepted for initial production; for EDI/UBL we can accept UBL 2.1 with invoiceNumber in the header. If you can provide Peppol endpoint later that’s preferred.
- VAT/tax: For US suppliers we need a completed tax form if billing over $600/month. For non-US suppliers, we require certificate of tax residency for VAT relief.

I’ve attached our AP wire template and vendor checklist (FreightLine_AP_Wire_Template.xlsx). I’m copying finance to expedite.

Can you: 1) confirm Redwood legal name exactly as you want it displayed on POs, 2) return the vendor registration info or the CSV, and 3) indicate whether you want 30/Net45/Net60 default terms (we can request early-pay options with a fee schedule).

Regards,
Elena Morales
Senior Procurement Manager
FreightLine Logistics
elena.morales@freightline.com

From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elena Morales <elena.morales@freightline.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-08-21T11:47:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor portal registration and PO/invoice routing — FreightLine

Elena,

Thanks — that all looks straightforward. Confirming the legal name to display on POs: 
"Redwood Inference, Inc."

Attached you’ll find: 
- Completed vendor registration CSV (included in the AP packet PDF)
- Signed tax form: Signed_Tax_Form_W-8BEN-E.pdf (for completeness; note we are US entity so W-9 available on request)

We’d like to start on Net30 standard terms. For early-pay (2% 10-day) please route the program details to Ben (payments) — he can evaluate and set up the ACH sweep. Ben — can you confirm whether we can accept FreightLine’s early-pay program and what netting requirements we’ll need?

If you can issue a test PO after you import the record, we’ll push a test invoice to verify remittance instructions and invoice acceptance in your portal. Also attaching a DocuSign envelope id for the vendor agreement if you need it: https://docusign.com/envelope/ABC12345

Appreciate the quick turnaround — happy to jump on a short call if you want to walk through the registration UI.

Best,
Rachel
